notes: Qal citation (Zeph.3.3, גָרְמוּ, "her judges are evening wolves; they [do not] leave [any bones] till the morning") supports the requested "leave; reserve" sense, but the lexicon's own primary/etymological sense for this root is "to bone, i.e. gnaw the bones" -- the same verse is also commonly read that way ("they gnaw not the bones till the morrow"). Both readings are attested interpretive traditions of the same citation; shipping the requested sense per the person's gloss, flagging the alternate reading rather than silently picking one.
